title: Canonical State
description: Accepted task-relevant state. This schema is not an execution trace and must not contain raw tool logs.

schema_version.description: Version of this schema used by the runtime.

state_id.description: Stable identifier for this canonical state snapshot.

task_intent.description: Accepted representation of the current task intent.

objects.description: Accepted task-relevant entities, not raw extracted context.

relations.description: Accepted task-relevant relationships among state objects.

events.description: Accepted state-relevant events only. This is not a complete execution trace or raw tool log.

uncertainty.description: Known uncertainty, conflicts, or unresolved state assumptions.

provenance.description: Source and version metadata for accepted state content.
